name: BUS_ENTERING_YELLOW_DIAMOND

qld_w5-q14_bus.desc: bus (side view, facing left, windows as yellow gaps), box e 258 each side of centre, d 82 above and below; vector path from the PDF (item 119), 531.5 x 169.1 as drawn on the sheet's 600 sign
qld_w5-q14_bus.vector: extracted from the sheet PDF (not traced)

notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W5-Q14 'Bus entering' warning sign (2023). Size A 600 diamond generated (B 750, C 900 also tabled): a 600 side drawn as the bounding square 848.53, r 40, b 10 yellow edge + c 20 black border (separate spans on the sheet). Symbol box from the table: e 258 each side of the vertical centreline (516 wide), d 82 above and below the horizontal centreline (164 tall), i.e. centred on the sign: x 166.27, y 342.27. The symbol is the sheet PDF's own vector path (tools/symbols/qld_w5-q14_bus.svg, vec2sym2, not traced; the windows are gaps showing the yellow ground), drawn 531.5 x 169.1 on the sheet's sign (3 % larger than the tabled box), scaled into the box. The sheet's colour legend lists white and yellow only (no black entry): the bus is drawn black, as on every other Q-series warning sign. Black on retroreflective yellow.
